title: Guide on creating a custom calendar widget
body:
A calendar widget can be pretty important in certain use case. However there are many out there and adding one would have a direct impact on the library size. Also this requires to format data in a specific way.

As a first step we should provide a guide that explains how to integrate a calendar and format the data correctly so that it can be leverages using numeric filters. Maybe we should talk about the case when we want a range and a single date.

It should be possible to base the implementation on the connectors we currently have.
